lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a construction time guard needs data a materialized fact or an evidence method that the approved factory signature does not carry wire it in via an explicit signature parameter or document it as a mandatory pre call for callers do not ship it as a standalone public guard whose only call site is its own test
lessons.text: When a construction-time guard needs data (a materialized fact or an evidence method) that the approved factory signature does not carry, wire it in via an explicit signature parameter or document it as a mandatory pre-call for callers -- do not ship it as a standalone public guard whose only call site is its own test.
